title: Bumper Tanks
description:
A childhood dream comes true. Play with your remote controlled tank, dash in the arena and eliminate others to become that last tank standing! 

DODGE. JUMP, SHOOT & DESTROY!
BUMPER TANKS is a 4-player local & online party game inspired by the classic couch multiplayer genre. It's all about intense versus matches that are easy to jump into, but difficult to truly master. You'll need serious skills to emerge victorious from the fierce tank battles that ensue. So gather your friends, grab some snacks, and get ready for some seriously blasting gameplay.

ABOUT ARVIS

We’re an independent studio aiming to create magical experiences through games that we’re developing. Bumper Tanks is an internal game jam project that we were excited to develop. BUMPER TANKS is currently in an early development stage, so pretty much everything in the game might change in the future. We are a small team and we are working on the game in our spare time.

Join our Discord server to take part in the future of the game, plus get access to early development updates.

description_short: Take control of a tank and dash into the fight in this couch multiplayer, fast-paced, twin-stick shooter game! Collect various power-ups to hook around the destructible environment and blast your friends with whatever it takes. Remember: One shot, One kill!
